definitions.explanation: Being suitable, proper, or at an appropriate level.

examples.japanese: {適正|てきせい}な⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: To sell at a fair price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{適正|てきせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{管理|かんり}する→管理する：21910_kanrisuru⟧。
{適正|てきせい}⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: To determine the appropriate number of people.

notes:
{適正|てきせい} indicates something is at the right or proper level.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適正|てきせい}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (fair price)
- {適正|てきせい}な⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (appropriate amount)
- {適正|てきせい}⟦{人数|にんずう}→人数：03132_ninzuu⟧ (appropriate number of people)
- {適正|てきせい}⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧ (proper use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧: appropriate, suitable (more about choosing correctly)
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧: suitable, appropriate (can also mean 'random/careless')
